meta.name: add-whatsapp
meta.description: Add WhatsApp channel via native Baileys adapter. Direct connection — no Chat SDK bridge. Uses QR code or pairing code for authentication.

copy.tagline: 通过二维码或配对码直连 WhatsApp 频道
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用中直接连接 WhatsApp 发送或接收消息。
copy.tagline_en: Connect WhatsApp channel via QR code or pairing code
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to directly connect WhatsApp in your app to send or receive messages.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 可以帮你把 WhatsApp 加为聊天通道。它用二维码或配对码完成手机验证,并区分“专用号码”和“个人号码”:个人号码时只出现在你的自聊里、不读别人消息;专用号码时作为独立联系人正常对话。
howto.when: 当用户要求添加或接入 WhatsApp 作为聊天通道时触发。若用户表示将使用个人日常号码,会先显示账号风险警告并要求确认。

say.text: 把 WhatsApp 加为聊天通道,我用二维码登录。
say.note: Claude 会准备连接并显示二维码。

say.text: 我用自己的个人号码,开始前先告诉我风险。
say.note: Claude 会先做号码安全检查再继续。

say.text: 用专用号码接入,让助手成为独立联系人。
say.note: Claude 会按专用模式配置,并询问你的另一号码。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude can add WhatsApp as a chat channel via QR or pairing-code auth. It handles two modes: shared/personal number (agent only in your self-chat, ignores others) or dedicated number (standalone contact, normal two-way chat).
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to add or connect WhatsApp as a chat channel. If they say the number is personal/everyday, a risk warning is shown and confirmation is needed before continuing.

say_en.text: Add WhatsApp as a chat channel; I'll log in with a QR code.
say_en.note: Claude starts the setup and shows a QR code.

say_en.text: I'll use my personal number; warn me about risks first.
say_en.note: Claude runs the safety check before continuing.

say_en.text: Use a dedicated number so the assistant is a separate contact.
say_en.note: Claude sets dedicated mode and asks for your other number.
